provenance.source: Offline fit from vendored Abdella parquet (ADR 0148); corridor duration families fixed, moments matched on n=6. Thermal model replaced by cold-chain break events (schema 2).
provenance.window: Refrigerated leg only: from first lot-mean T < 10 C through published Table 2 duration.

adjustment_notes.gamma: arrival reference_life_days=26 (gamma_scale=1/52): f|Lambda mapping tuned for US retail cold-chain (~65-85% median arrival f at multilot Λ); in-store eta_ref=14 unchanged via ModelParams.set_reference_life
adjustment_notes.sigma_pos: keep 0.08 (lognormal psi scale; not identified from n=6; probe temperature sd is not sigma_pos)
adjustment_notes.legs: Nominal stage setpoints and mean shares (w_k). ASSUMED anchors for clean-chain phi_bar centre (~1.36); compressed setpoints (0.35/2.58/4.32 C) reduce Dirichlet stage-share spread driving phi_bar SD.
adjustment_notes.thermal_modes: Trip-wide cool/nominal/warm mode mix and offset_c values are ASSUMED (p_c=0.10, p_n=0.80, p_w=0.10; offsets -0.12/0/+0.22 C). Tuned under rho=0 for phi_bar SD, not fit from six traces.
adjustment_notes.sigma_hour: Hourly OU amplitude (0.028 C) is ASSUMED for chart realism and rho=0 phi_bar scatter; not fit from six traces.
adjustment_notes.breaks: rho (breaks per transit-day), tau_bar (mean break duration, days), and T_break are ASSUMED, NOT FITTED. All six Abdella shipments are clean chains with no cold-chain break, so a break frequency is not estimable from this data at any confidence. rho=0.08 / tau_bar=0.5 / T_break=12 put a typical break at ~1.2 reference-days and the duration share of Var(log Lambda) at ~82%, versus 100% at rho=0. Treat these numbers as a documented modelling regime, not a measurement.

provenance.notes: Six strawberry logger shipments (not MLE-validated). Arrival freshness remains an upper bound (field heat excluded). short_haul = S2; long_haul = S1,S3-S6. Schema 2 replaces the truncated-normal mean transit temperature (mu_T/sigma_T/temp_floor_c) with a deterministic legged baseline plus compound-Poisson break events; the temperature trace is now the generative primitive and Lambda is integrated out of it.
